Name: L_Clavicle
Description: This will create a Clavicle system.

attrs.Help_string: What this block does: This will create a Clavicle system. How to use it: fill the key fields below before build. SetParent: set the target node name. If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup. Mirror: choose one option (for example: True, False, Right_Only). CtrlType: choose one option (for example: square, sphere, cube, octagon). CtrlSize: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 4). SetGameParent: set the node/object name this block should use. Tip: start with defaults, build once, then tweak only the fields you need. Template parent examples: L_Clavicle_Jnt, L_Clavicle_Ctrl, StellarClavicle.
